name: Leonid Barthalomew

narrative.details:
I received a message from my master, Vectus.  Well, the message wasn't really from Vectus...it was from someone named Leonid Barthalomew.  I don't know Leonid, but he knew my master, and no one knows my master unless he allows it.

Leonid says Vectus wants the dragon eggs.  He wants you to deliver them to him at the Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

That hurts!  Why you?  Doesn't Vectus trust me?  Oh, never mind... just take the eggs and tell Leonid that I did what our master commanded.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Frozen Eggs to Leonid Barthalomew in the Eastern Plaguelands.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah, very good. You do not know the evil power for whom you have labored, but now you will know the truth. And fear not--I am no servant of that master. I am Leonid Barthalomew, known as "the Revered" to my brethren in the Argent Dawn.

I tricked Tinkee into sending you and the dragon eggs to me. And it is good that my trick was successful, for had these eggs reached their intended destination, a great power would have fallen into the hands of the enemy.
narrative.requestItemsText: You are the one up to mischief in Blackrock Spire, yes? Do you have what I asked for?

chain.subtitle: 10 quests from level 52 to 60, 51,400 XP in all.

quests.objectiveText: Bring 8 Broodling Essence and the Draco-Incarcinatrix 900 to Tinkee Steamboil at the Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.

quests.objectiveText: Bring 8 Uncracked Chillwind Horns to Felnok Steelspring.

quests.name: Return to Tinkee
quests.objectiveText: Bring Felnok's Package to Tinkee Steamboil in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Egg Freezing
quests.objectiveText: Use the Eggscilloscope Prototype on an egg in the Rookery.

quests.name: Egg Collection
quests.objectiveText: Bring 8 Collected Dragon Eggs and the Collectronic Module to Tinkee Steamboil at Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Leonid Barthalomew
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Frozen Eggs to Leonid Barthalomew in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Betina Bigglezink
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Frozen Eggs to Betina Bigglezink.

quests.name: Dawn's Gambit
quests.objectiveText: Place Dawn's Gambit in the Viewing Room of the Scholomance.
